drhp.business: KFintech provides end-to-end technology-led investor and issuer solutions across the investment lifecycle, including digital onboarding, transaction processing, fund administration, and compliance reporting. The company serves asset managers, corporate issuers, and financial institutions globally, operating across mutual funds, alternatives, private markets, pensions, and wealth ecosystems. Its platform integrates deeply into client operations, creating high switching costs and recurring, annuity-like revenues.
